description: This file contains mock database setup, data models, and service functions for user authentication, social interactions, chat, and stories in a messaging app.

methods.name: handleSignUp
methods.description: Registers a new user, adds to mock database, and stores user ID in local storage.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Authenticates user by email and password, stores user ID in local storage.

methods.name: handleGoogleSignIn
methods.description: Simulates Google sign-in, retrieves mock Google user, and stores user ID.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Removes current user ID from local storage.

methods.name: getUserById
methods.description: Fetches user data by ID, excluding password.

methods.name: searchUsersByName
methods.description: Searches users by name excluding current user.

methods.name: handleSendFriendRequest
methods.description: Sends a friend request from one user to another.

methods.name: getFriendRequests
methods.description: Retrieves pending friend requests received by a user.

methods.name: handleAcceptFriendRequest
methods.description: Accepts a friend request, updates friends list, and creates a chat.

methods.name: handleDeclineFriendRequest
methods.description: Declines a friend request, removing it from requests lists.

methods.name: populateChat
methods.description: Populates chat object with message details and user info without passwords.

methods.name: getChatsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all chats for a user.

methods.name: getChatById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific chat by ID.

methods.name: handleSendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message in a chat.

methods.name: getStories
methods.description: Retrieves all stories and associated users.

methods.name: getStoryForUser
methods.description: Retrieves a specific user's story and user info.
